exposure: Cervical dilation at time of induction
outcome: Vaginal birth after induction of labor (IOL)
cohort: 1123 pregnant women who underwent IOL between April and December 2016 at Mount Sinai Hospital, Toronto, Canada
finding: Researchers developed and internally validated a clinical prediction model for vaginal birth after IOL, identifying maternal age, parity, pre-pregnancy BMI, weight at delivery, and cervical dilation at induction as significant predictors.
